My first save was mistakenly visible to everyone in the workspace. I withdrew it right away and saved the private version in its place. The withdrawn copy is no longer active, but it stays in the audit trail.

I checked for an earlier dock you'd given me and found none. That search was keyword-only, though, so an older note worded differently could still be there. If you remember telling me a different dock before, let me know and I'll remove it.
